findings.what: The secret that user-service signs login tokens with was changed.
The gateway still checks tokens with the old secret.

evidence.quote: Users can log in, but nothing works after login.

if_intended.fix_what: Set the new secret in the gateway too and restart it.

if_mistake.fix_what: Put the old secret back in service-config.json and restart user-service.

open_question: Was the JWT signing secret rotated on purpose, and which value is the current one?
